This file documents the agent_grants resource at the shell, one section per command. Every command is a subcommand of =agent_grants=, and every section exports its own script into =projects/ores.shell/scripts/library/=. Loading a script runs that one command, so a failure names the command it came from.

** =list=
:PROPERTIES:
:ID: F30BC542-31E3-54A0-A3E4-E7143548BFB7
:END:

Reads one page of the collection. Nothing addresses it but the caller's tenant, so it is the read that shows what exists.


The command is shaped like this:

#+begin_example
agent_grants list [--offset <n>] [--limit <n>] [--order <field>] [--desc]
#+end_example

It is addressed at =iam.v1.agent_grants.list=.

#+name: agent_grants-list
#+begin_src ores-shell :tangle agent_grants-list.ores :exports none
agent_grants list --limit 1
#+end_src

** =get=
:PROPERTIES:
:ID: A8EB7750-3462-541C-9C73-52C5B3EA2F4F

Reads the one row its key addresses. A key states every identifying column, so a partial key is refused rather than answered with an arbitrary row.


The command is shaped like this:

#+begin_example

#+end_example

It is addressed at =iam.v1.agent_grants.get=.

#+end_src
